programme.desc: 莉塔终于离渡渡鸟足够接近来抚摸它—但只是因为牠弄伤了脚。她把这只小动物带回家,用爱喂养牠,还给牠吃太多的食物。现在超重的渡渡鸟非常需要运动。莉塔明白到所谓的关心,是要对他人有好处,而不是对自己有益。如此一来,现在有了一个新的好朋友。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #9
programme.desc: 在看似平常的一天,姑毛出去慢跑时发现今天的啫堡略有不同。一切都停止不动!音乐停了。渡渡鸟停留在空中。连他的朋友们都僵硬得像雕像!这取决于姑毛和他有用的耳机来找出发生了甚么事,并让啫堡再次动起来。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #10
programme.desc: 在啫堡上探索春天的音乐本质时,姑毛意识到他害怕唱歌花。为了寻找治疗方法,米娜进行了一系列测试,以帮助姑毛处理他对唱歌植物的过度反应。最后姑毛意识到,当你了解自己的恐惧,就没甚么可怕的了。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #11
programme.desc: 姑毛发现了一个嘈杂的重金属摇滚音乐盒,他认为这很棒,但却令啫堡的其他人都抓狂。必须做点甚么!比路和米娜骗了姑毛并用魔术让盒子「消失」。没有了他的「劲爆音乐」盒子,姑毛十分苦恼。比路和米娜意识到音乐对姑毛有多重要,并让盒子重新出现。姑毛在过程中意识到即使他们不喜欢他的音乐也没关系,他有很多音乐盒可以满

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #12
programme.desc: 由于国王的奇怪睡眠习惯,女王把他赶出了城堡。被黑影和不寻常的声音所笼罩,国王立即到比路的房子寻求庇护,但他们离睡个好觉还很远。经过一系列奇怪的睡前仪式,比路终于明白问题所在,并帮助国王克服对夜晚的恐惧。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #13
programme.desc: 姑毛在啫喱莓树林里睡著了。国王在附近尝试用一台异常强大的机器打开他的汽水瓶,这台机器最终撞倒了啫喱树!姑毛在废墟中惊恐地醒来!他说服自己是罪魁祸首!比路和米娜收集线索,让国王为自己的行为负责,并让姑毛认清事实。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #50
programme.desc: 当其他人都得到赞扬和掌声时,要站著面对并不总是那么容易。比路尝试在他朋友的表演中抢尽风头,让他们非常沮丧,比路需要分享他的一些才能来解决问题。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #51
programme.desc: 比路和姑毛发现城堡里的所有玩具都放在一个盒子里,他们面对著一项几乎不可能完成的任务。虽然诱惑很大,但他们接到严格的命令,不能碰盒子,因为他们肯定会弄得一团糟。他们能服从命令,让城堡一尘不染吗?

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #52
programme.desc: 还有比在音乐诞生的星球更适合跳舞的地方吗?啫堡上的每个人都会向您展示一段舞蹈,这样我们就可以随著啫堡的节奏一起跳舞。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #1
programme.desc: 比露使用超级生长配方,让植物(和渡渡鸟)抓狂并失控!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #2
programme.desc: 米娜想成为啫堡上的万人迷!她尝试在啫堡举办有史以来最好的派对!当她的四阶段乐趣计划未能为人们实现「最大乐趣」,她学会冷静下来,并听取朋友们的意见,了解如何让美好时光发生。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #3
programme.desc: 米娜不情愿地接受一项帮助迷路渡渡鸟的任务。莉塔自称「很了解」渡渡鸟,却让事情变得更糟。经过长时间的寻找,多得米娜的失败实验,渡渡鸟的父母被诱到牠们丢失的宝贝身边。即使渡渡鸟回到自己的家,米娜却交到一位心爱的小伙伴。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #4
programme.desc: 比路和姑毛承诺在莉塔去森林和渡渡鸟玩耍时照看她最喜欢的洋娃娃公主,但他们去玩啫喱波时却忘记了约定。无人看管的公主被想要向皇家访客展示他王国的国王抓住。男孩们必须围攻城堡,才能在莉塔回来前找到公主。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #5
programme.desc: 比路和姑毛化身成超级英雄啫堡侠和拍档侠,创造了奇幻的冒险,让他们碰上同样想扮演超级英雄的米娜和安高。结果导致一场关于超级英雄游戏规则的争论。当四位超级英雄崇拜者被召集到一场真正的冒险时,一切变成空谈:拯救被困在啫堡谷悬崖峭壁上的莉塔。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #6
programme.desc: 姑毛认为比路是他最好的朋友。不过,比路也是这样想吗?姑毛开始考验他们的友谊,但不断的考验却适得其反,令双方都不开心,他们去和「其他朋友」一起玩,但他们发现没有人比你的死党更有趣,也更了解你的特性。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #7

programme.title: 动物全明星 2 #2

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #11
programme.desc: 姑毛发现了一个嘈杂的重金属摇滚音乐盒,他认为这很棒,但却令啫堡的其他人都抓狂。必须做点甚么!比路和米娜骗了姑毛并用魔术让盒子「消失」。没有了他的「劲爆音乐」盒子,姑毛十分苦恼。比路和米娜意识到音乐对姑毛有多重要,并让盒子重新出现。姑毛在过程中意识到即使他们不喜欢他的音乐也没关系,他有很多音乐盒可以满

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #12
programme.desc: 由于国王的奇怪睡眠习惯,女王把他赶出了城堡。被黑影和不寻常的声音所笼罩,国王立即到比路的房子寻求庇护,但他们离睡个好觉还很远。经过一系列奇怪的睡前仪式,比路终于明白问题所在,并帮助国王克服对夜晚的恐惧。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #13
programme.desc: 姑毛在啫喱莓树林里睡著了。国王在附近尝试用一台异常强大的机器打开他的汽水瓶,这台机器最终撞倒了啫喱树!姑毛在废墟中惊恐地醒来!他说服自己是罪魁祸首!比路和米娜收集线索,让国王为自己的行为负责,并让姑毛认清事实。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #14
programme.desc: 米娜发明了一个巨型机器人来给啫堡换灯泡。比路认为机械人应该用来保护啫堡免受入侵者的侵扰!在米娜不知情的情况下,他修改了「啫堡机械人」的程式,导致它发生故障,并大肆破坏啫喱星。比路明白了「别碰我的东西!」这句话背后的含义。

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 2 #3
programme.desc: 一把神秘的尖叫声回荡在塔斯曼尼亚森林中。小游侠能否解救被困在深沟中的烦躁袋獾?

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 2 #4
programme.desc: 嘉豪声称发现了一种全新的动物物种—它有水獭的皮毛和身体、鸭子的蹼足和喙,以及海狸一样的尾巴。嘉豪兽需要帮助!

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 2 #5
programme.desc: 这是复活节!小游侠必须让一只巨大的鸸鹋蛋与它的父母团聚。

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 2 #6
programme.desc: 小游侠能否智取奇亚并取回他们的吉普车钥匙?

programme.title: 忍者龟之都市传奇 英普
programme.desc: 拉斐尔的兄弟都不懂他,他就是需要打斗!他的新教练薯仔也说他很擅长打斗而兄弟间虽然彼此不对盘,仍必须合作阻止咆勃跟摇滚万岁大闹纽约!

programme.title: 海绵宝宝 英普
programme.desc: 珊迪寻求章鱼哥的帮助拯救她生病的树,但他另类的园艺技巧却让她头痛不已 海绵宝宝和章鱼哥寻找送给蟹老板的完美生日礼物

programme.title: 海绵宝宝 英普
programme.desc: 在珊迪教导姊妹淘空手道后,各个变得势不可挡,很快地,全镇的人都加入了空手道的行列 皮老板渗透凯伦和她电脑朋友的聚会,但凯伦很快就识破了他的诡计

programme.title: 海绵宝宝 英普
programme.desc: 当章鱼哥试图证明任何人都能画漫画时,他的作品竟然吸引了一群疯狂的粉丝 一位演员为了准备自己下一部大片的角色,开始跟著海绵宝宝观察并模仿他的生活

programme.desc: 梅丽嫦与冯志伟相恋，惜被梅父反对。伟往国外谋职，出发前与嫦一夕缠绵。其后嫦怀了伟的骨肉，芳唯有讹称自己有孕。伟承继了遗产回港，众人以为他是孩子的父亲，惹起一场风波，此时嫦诞子，芳说明一切，终真相大白。

programme.title: 铁马神龙
programme.desc: 胡人入侵马家村，马明章之父被卖国土豪彭冬发手下打死，章被逐出村。章妻林淑英为生计当发女小碧的乳娘，与章分离。多年后，章派两名儿子往马家村打探，两子被擒。英与碧帮忙救人，碧最终更化解了彭、马两家的仇怨。

programme.title: 水浒传

programme.title: 两地相思

programme.title: 战地笳声海棠红
programme.desc: 天虹国主帅盖天鸿向海棠国下战书，海棠公主遂往芙蓉国欲游说联盟抵抗，却被鸿截获，鸿一念之仁放走她。海棠国得援兵相助，鸿兵败如山倒被擒。海棠公主不忍恩将仇报，求国王放过鸿。其后鸿更凭玉珮认回亲妹芙蓉公主。

programme.title: 改造小姐
programme.desc: 富家子何家强与田均、杜莉莉遇上乡村姑娘杨小燕，强认为燕经特训后，必成摩登女性，遂与均、莉打赌，并以半年时间为限。燕因不惯名媛淑女的礼仪而闹出笑话。强对燕日久生情，而燕学有所成惜合约期满，燕留信离去……

programme.title: 血绣鞋
programme.desc: 陈汉希与表妹李紫英互生情愫，惜英无奈下嫁庞树中。英撞破中的奸情被杀，中把英的绣花鞋藏于希的房内嫁祸希，更派人放火杀希。当晚英原来未死，遇中表弟琪，琪色心顿起，英被逼跳河。希假扮僵尸吓中，中终自揭真相。

programme.title: 魔爪神鞭
programme.desc: 李剑鸿求姻缘，竟娶得化身为青蛙的荷花仙子为妻。蝙蝠精掳去花，鸿与兄长前往营救，伏魔仙姬试出鸿之真诚，以神鞭助他消灭蝠，可惜花已遭毒手。鸿不惜牺牲性命救回花，仙翁被二人情深所感动，赐予灵芝草，让鸿复活。

programme.title: 金兰姊妹
programme.desc: 阿彩、阿好、阿钻、阿三皆为女佣，各有不幸遭遇。阿彩认识了有钱少爷杜仑，一心以为可以结婚享福，可是当阿彩怀有杜仑骨肉，并借钱予他后，才发现杜仑已有妻子。阿好尽心尽力服侍陆家三十多年，更借钱给主人陆云璋做生意，结果却被嫌弃年老而遭解雇。阿钻为姪儿何通觅得妻子，但因迷信而没有将病重的何通送院医治，令何通病死。阿三努力工作储钱入斋堂，却误信生神仙之言，差点被骗去毕生积蓄，幸得阿英识破，更鼓励各人勇敢生活。

programme.title: 节妇审贪官
programme.desc: 麦中昌投军后，其兄麦伯和假传昌死讯夺家产。和妻甘氏指使张器劫和，器却误杀和，于是甘氏嫁祸给昌妻李玉娥。甘氏与知府胡恩有染，娥被判处斩。昌立功当官归来欲重审案件，恩拒并即行刑，幸器良心发现，娥沉冤得雪。

programme.title: 得咗
programme.desc: 马祥与李核、天娜兄妹得万事通所聘，祥被派往照顾病重的富翁周公。周公的侄儿大伟及其妹等人觊觎周公家财，幸祥尽心照顾，周公病情好转，愤而赶伟等人离去。伟诱核吸毒，更逼娜色诱周公继而勒索，祥得悉后报警救人。

programme.title: 亲上加亲
programme.desc: 李家驹对与表嫂叶曼丝外貌相似的施曼珠一见倾心。丝因丈夫汪继昌嗜赌，愤而离家，众人误将珠带回家。驹在昌家遇上珠，却误认是丝。珠以丝身份试探驹，却被昌误会，时丝母带丝回家，认出珠是丝的孪生妹妹，误会尽消。

programme.title: 花好月圆
programme.desc: 陈佩娥为家境所逼而嫁富商刘绍基为妾，婚后受基妻逼害，苦不堪言。娥本与郑中坚相恋，坚为挣钱出外谋生，并允诺回来娶娥。数年后，坚欲与娥重新开始，基得悉后与坚争执，混乱间娥被车撞倒。基知错，惜娥已返魂乏术。

programme.title: 节妇审贪官

programme.title: 极速先锋普

programme.title: 新扎师妹粤普

programme.title: 胭脂扣粤
programme.desc: 1934年的香港陈振邦(十二少)(张国荣 饰)是南北行海味店的太子爷,是个经常出入鸦片烟窟,风月场所的花花公子,他遇上了石塘咀倚红楼「红牌阿姑」(名妓)如花(梅艳芳 饰),二人旋即陷入热恋但是,十二少的父母不接纳他们的关系,希望十二少可以与其表妹淑贤(温碧霞 饰)结婚承继家业,十二少在如花的帮助下学戏但不成功最后在山穷水尽下,于1934年3月8日晚上11时,十二少与如花吞食鸦片殉情自尽

programme.title: 无双粤普
programme.desc: 伪钞画师李问在泰国因制作假钞,遭人密报被捕入狱香港警方将他引渡回港,当律政司要检控之际,国宝级画家阮文前来保释,双方达成协议 - 如果李问能够供出伪钞集团主脑画家真正身份,便可转为污点证人故事开始追溯至1985年的温哥华,李问跟阮文本是一对情侣画家,其后阮文的作品受人欣赏且拥有专属经纪人,然而李问却因为作品原创性不足,只能靠偷偷制作仿真画维生有回无意间被阮文戳破,双方起了争执,两人渐行

programme.title: 阿二一族粤

programme.title: 神枪手与咖喱鸡粤普
programme.desc: 岑健昌与江理基是香港皇家警察中的两名干探,两人因为身手了得,手法火爆,屡破奇案身手所以在警界,有棘手双雄之称故事的发生是因为有一帮会的龙头大哥被人暗杀,警方估计将会有可能引起连串的江湖大火拼,所以派出在警界有枪王之称的枪王英主持调查该案,而岑健昌与江理基则负责协助枪王英调查起初两人不服枪王英的办事方法,处处发生冲突,直至枪王英向两人表现出其精湛的枪法及其对枪械的丰富知识,两人才开始对枪王

programme.title: 花花型警粤普

programme.title: 秋天的童话粤
programme.desc: 美丽而骄纵的年轻姑娘十三妹(Jenny)(钟楚红 饰)只身从香港赴纽约攻读大学,并探望先她赴美的男友Vincent(陈百强 饰)前来机场接她的,是一个在唐人街打工的远房亲戚船头尺(周润发 饰)(「船头尺」是双关语,意思是「度水」,在香港俗语中为借钱的意思)满口脏话,粗俗不堪的船头尺被人看作「烂鬼」船头尺初时对十三妹感到厌烦,并称她为「茶煲」(即英文的trouble,麻烦的意思)nn十

programme.title: 武状元苏乞儿粤
programme.desc: 天理教太乙真人入主朝廷,势力日大,到处迫害丐帮,原来上一代丐帮四大长老杀了天理教前任教主,两败俱伤,而丐帮帮主也阵亡,丐帮四分五裂,于是功长老选出灿为新任帮主灿团结各地丐帮会员自强,对抗天理教

programme.title: 桃姐粤普
programme.desc: 本片改编自真人真事,讲述生长于大家庭梁家的少爷Roger与自幼照顾自己长大的家佣妈钟春桃之间所发生的一段温暖人心的主仆情故事:桃姐13岁就到梁家当妈姐,转眼60年过去,她已伺候了梁家老少四代人梁家人有的去世,有的移民了,近十年间只剩下桃姐和梁家少爷Roger在一起生活,主仆两人相处颇有默契但很少交流后来有一天,桃姐突然中风,Roger把她送去安养院,由此展开了一段触动人心的主仆情

programme.title: 高度戒备粤普

programme.title: 千王之王2000粤普
programme.desc: 老千法拉利在香港以上流社会身份周旋富豪当中重案组探员宽,以卧底身份混入法家参与豪门宴,发现其家人全是肥人,当进行拘捕行动时,全屋布置已改,法家全是瘦人宽混入监狱拜姐夫黄师虎求教本领,黄帮他对付法,虎扮成马来西亚富商出现法家

programme.title: 喋血双雄粤
programme.desc: 阿庄(周润发 饰)是一个职业杀手,因为在「工作」时被发现而遭雇主解雇,然而开枪时的火光意外令年轻夜总会歌手珍妮失明(叶蒨文 饰)为了帮助珍妮,阿庄筹了一大笔钱来替她做恢复视力的眼角膜移植阿庄惹来一个警探李鹰(李修贤 饰)调查他的犯罪,最终两人因缘际会地遇上因为见到阿庄先前救过一名小女孩,再得知珍妮的手术后,李鹰明白到,逮捕这个杀手并不能达到正义电影的高潮,是两人与三合会在废弃的教堂内

programme.title: 黑金粤
programme.desc: 法务部调查局干员兼机动小组组长方国辉(刘德华饰)为人嫉恶如仇,干练打击社会不法活动,第一目标是当时危害社会的赌博电玩,调查结果发现此案背后的幕后藏镜人是黑帮老大周朝先(梁家辉饰);周朝先的事业不断被公家扫荡,于是在记者会上公开声明要参选立法委员,设法由黑道转换到台湾政治舞台,想借由民意代表的保护伞拯救自己,并从此当中得到政治保护,周朝先不惜贿赂政府官员及政党权贵,甚至以挲圆仔汤的方式进行围标

programme.title: 喜爱夜蒲3粤普

programme.title: 惊天救援普

programme.title: 进化的奥秘 #3
programme.desc: 动物界中一些最有趣的适应性是无形的研究这些隐藏的内部变化,以观察不同的动物如何用惊人且看不见的方式进化并生存

programme.title: 宁格鲁:澳大利亚的海洋奇观 #1
programme.desc: 与蒂姆、当地土著和其他专家一同观察塑造宁格鲁珊瑚礁、开普山脉和埃克斯茅斯湾的自然与人为力量欣赏有百万年历史的珊瑚礁化石、一条巨大的鱼和令人震撼的鳐鱼

programme.title: 宁格鲁:澳大利亚的海洋奇观 #2
programme.desc: 跟随科学家和当地土著一起规划保护宁格鲁生物多样性的生态联系、迁徙途径和物种纽带与鲸鱼嬉戏,在海藻岛之间漂浮,见证考古学家揭穿定居者的神话

programme.desc: 地球上最具代表性的动物之一 - 孟加拉虎在印度的丛林中徘徊在一天的过程中,我们追随一位母亲和三只幼崽 她必须为家人提供足够的食物来维持生计

programme.title: 宁格鲁:澳大利亚的海洋奇观 #1
programme.desc: 与蒂姆、当地土著和其他专家一同观察塑造宁格鲁珊瑚礁、开普山脉和埃克斯茅斯湾的自然与人为力量欣赏有百万年历史的珊瑚礁化石、一条巨大的鱼和令人震撼的鳐鱼

programme.title: 宁格鲁:澳大利亚的海洋奇观 #2
programme.desc: 跟随科学家和当地土著一起规划保护宁格鲁生物多样性的生态联系、迁徙途径和物种纽带与鲸鱼嬉戏,在海藻岛之间漂浮,见证考古学家揭穿定居者的神话

programme.title: 深入印度 #5 英普
programme.desc: 地球上最具代表性的动物之一 - 孟加拉虎在印度的丛林中徘徊在一天的过程中,我们追随一位母亲和三只幼崽 她必须为家人提供足够的食物来维持生计

programme.title: 奇异地球 #3 英普
programme.desc: 拜会自然界中最受关注的物种,暸解为何最坏的伙伴并未得到应有的尊重看看大白鲨的电力感应器、枯叶螳螂的锋利肢体、以及虫草菌炼成「僵尸」的能力

programme.title: 奇异地球 #4 英普
programme.desc: 窥探确保物种在野外互利共生的奇特联盟探索小丑鱼和海葵之间的伙伴关系,观察牛椋鸟如何保持草原居民的健康,并揭开粪金龟和猪笼草之间的互利关系

programme.title: 空中战士 11 #7

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 2 #7
programme.desc: 詹姆斯和奥利弗与斯坦尼斯拉夫·伊恩奈夫斯基一同踏上前往科莫湖的公路之旅途经法国葡萄园与瑞士阿尔卑斯山,他们学习钟表制造、征服险峻的富尔卡隘口,最终在科莫湖上以轻松的游船之旅结束行程

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 2 #8
programme.desc: 在巴塔哥尼亚,双胞胎与马修·路易斯于蓬塔阿雷纳斯会合他们徒步前往百内塔基地营、回忆《哈利波特》的拍摄点滴、跟随当地牧民(Baqueanos)学习赶羊与骑马,并利用夜视摄影机捕捉野生美洲狮的踪影

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 2 #1
programme.desc: 在贝里斯,詹姆斯与奥利弗·菲力普斯与阿尔菲·伊诺奇相聚他们探索拉马奈的玛雅遗址、走访水洞、了解门诺会文化、巡礼圣佩德罗的街头美食、飞越蓝洞,并在霍尔香珊瑚礁潜水

programme.title: 纽约美食指南 #1
programme.desc: 准备好迎接一场史诗般的纽约美食大探险吧!贾斯汀(Justine)来到 Russ Daughters 品尝招牌贝果,沉浸在德卡尔布市场(DeKalb Market)充满活力的热闹氛围中,并大口享用经典的纽约切片披萨这为终极的美食冒险拉开了激动人心且风味十足的序幕!

programme.title: 纽约美食指南 #2
programme.desc: 味蕾之旅大爆发!贾斯汀探索了美国烹饪学院(Culinary Institute),在 Essies 餐厅品尝了融合加勒比海与美国南方风味的大胆创意料理,并买了香甜的义大利奶油甜馅煎饼卷(cannolis)在风景如画的白脱牛奶瀑布(Buttermilk Falls)野餐后,她前往传奇的 Moose

programme.title: 纽约美食指南 #3
programme.desc: 一场狂野的市场之旅正等著您!贾斯汀一头栽进盐城市场(Salt City Market),在奥农达加湖(Onondaga Lake)湖畔烹调墨西哥卷饼,并大啖烟熏风味的 Dinosaur BBQ 烤肉最后,她在风景优美的卡南代瓜(Canandaigua)享用黏糊糊的花生酱烤棉花糖巧克力夹心饼(sm

programme.title: 纽约美食指南 #4
programme.desc: 美食惊喜持续不断!贾斯汀将当地 Living Roots 酒庄的葡萄酒与丰盛的义式玉米糊(polenta)完美搭配,欣赏令人叹为观止的尼加拉瀑布(Niagara Falls),并造访指标性的 Anchor Bar,大口品尝最正宗的水牛城辣鸡翅!纯粹的美味与令人惊艳的美景在此完美交会

programme.title: 纽约美食指南 #5
programme.desc: 贾斯汀在水牛城大啖经典的烤牛肉午餐,随后乘船启航,前往壮丽的千岛群岛(1000 Islands)和博尔特城堡(Boldt Castle)!在风景如画的水域沿岸一边烹饪、一边探索,最后她在奢华的萨加莫尔度假村(Sagamore Resort)为这难忘的一天画上休止符

programme.title: 纽约美食指南 #6
programme.desc: 盛大的压轴好戏火热登场!贾斯汀在 Toad Hill 枫糖农场搭配新鲜糖浆制作了苹果煎饼,接著大啖萨拉托加(Saratoga)炸鸡,最后在 River Market Bar and Kitchen 享用了一顿令人难忘的最终盛宴,为她这场史诗般的纽约冒险带来最完美的加冕!

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #7
programme.desc: 长颈鹿婴儿遇上族群,动物园的五个水獭兄弟正在移动,冷血动物团队正寻找隐藏的宝藏

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #8
programme.desc: 动物园兽医们在今集竭力拯救地球上最濒危的鸟类之一,过程使他们十分焦虑;而冷血动物团队正在野生的南岛执行任务

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #9
programme.desc: 今集,动物园在沼泽森林欢迎两只鳄鱼,新的东南亚栖息地开张,团队准备为南方白犀牛宝宝庆生

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #6
programme.desc: 有蹄类动物团队在今集准备接生,我们遇到最长寿动物之一,奥克兰动物园协助拯救濒危的巨物

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #4
programme.desc: 大象团队在今集迎来令人震惊的消息,兽医们担心他们救助的一只小企鹅,我们也了解到如何真正需要一个社区来为动物园提供食物

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #2
programme.desc: 奥克兰动物园的兽医团队开始进行加护治疗来拯救一只被鱼线缠住的濒危海龟的生命在动物园欠缺老虎三年后,团队准备好迎接一只新的大猫

programme.title: 街头美食通 #2
programme.desc: 安斯利到访加勒比海地区,他在后巷冒险寻觅真正的当地食物他与当地人共度时光,和好味道先生在海滩上做煎饼和超赞的鱼糕,并尝试了有史以来最辣的辣酱

programme.title: 街头美食通 #3
programme.desc: 安斯利前往冰岛雷克雅未克,发现一种真心刺激的传统和现代美食他用大蒜牛油烹调经典的挪威龙虾,还有腌三文鱼和柠汁鱼生,麦芽面包和在间歇泉中焗制的蛋糕

programme.title: 街头美食通 #4
programme.desc: 安斯利的街头美食长征于大阪落幕,他在当地发现了制作大阪烧的艺术,有点像用班㦸包裹的英国早餐,尝试日本风的小食,并制作生蚝天妇罗和辣虾乌冬

programme.title: 非凡工程 2 #5
programme.desc: 自2017年以来,风力发电已成为德国第二大能源全国有近 30,000台风力涡轮机在运作,覆盖约19%的能源消耗

programme.title: 生存边缘 #1
programme.desc: 《生存边缘》检视全球生物圈所面临的存亡威胁,以及对地球和奥特亚罗瓦(纽西兰)的未来代表著甚么

programme.title: 生存边缘 #2
programme.desc: 《生存边缘》探索人类有史以来面临的最大存亡风险之一的未来- 一个生化威胁从病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威胁的风险

programme.desc: 在挪威,前卫建筑师谢提尔托森以颠覆性的思维重新定义建筑——从可行走的歌剧院到沉入海中的餐厅,他的设计挑战我们对空间的想像

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: Kabul, Just Before Darkness
programme.desc: A Swiss Italian television crew was in Kabul in the days leading up to the surrender and was able to document the growing anguish of a society that feels the end of a hope cultivated for twenty years Social, civil and democratic achievements, especially those made by women, are being swept away It is also the starting point for a reflection on the fight against terrorism

programme.title: The Huddle
programme.desc: Though separated by a stretch of sea, Glasgow and Belfast share elements of political, sporting and religious culture rooted in the difficult, unresolved events faced by the Irish community during the twentieth century The Huddle tells the stories of two Irish communities brought together by a devotion to the Celtic Football Club, and a shared faith in football Exploring the contradictions between two cities facing radical ideological divides yet brought together by full stadiums, these are the interwoven and personal accounts of journalists, musicians, political militants, IRA fighters—all united by their love of football—on what it means to be Irish

programme.desc: Continuing his quest for belief, host Tevya get's a fresh look at the history and traditions of the Hasidic Jews (a little different to the Judaism he was used to) Rabbi Kaplan and some new friends offer insight into the most important passage in a Jewish boy's life, the Bar Mitzvah, celebrate Purim and have dinner with the Rabbi's family Can Rabbi Kaplan reveal the answer to one of the burning questions - why can't Jews eat bacon?

programme.title: Kabul, Just Before Darkness
programme.desc: A Swiss Italian television crew was in Kabul in the days leading up to the surrender and was able to document the growing anguish of a society that feels the end of a hope cultivated for twenty years Social, civil and democratic achievements, especially those made by women, are being swept away It is also the starting point for a reflection on the fight against terrorism

programme.title: The Huddle
programme.desc: Though separated by a stretch of sea, Glasgow and Belfast share elements of political, sporting and religious culture rooted in the difficult, unresolved events faced by the Irish community during the twentieth century The Huddle tells the stories of two Irish communities brought together by a devotion to the Celtic Football Club, and a shared faith in football Exploring the contradictions between two cities facing radical ideological divides yet brought together by full stadiums, these are the interwoven and personal accounts of journalists, musicians, political militants, IRA fighters—all united by their love of football—on what it means to be Irish

programme.title: Silent Forests
programme.desc: More than half of the Central-African forest elephant population has been decimated by poachers in the last decade Following one of Cameroon’s first female eco-guards, a grassroots law enforcement group, a Congolese biologist, a reformed poacher and a Czech activist, this intimate portrait gains remarkable access to an under-reported region, the Congo Basin, to understand the global poaching and…

programme.title: One Bride, Seven Cows or a Box of Heroin
programme.desc: Girls sold for school fees, for heroin From Vietnam’s Mei to Afghanistan’s Mujgan, their stories

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Qing turmoil sparked plots to empty Imperial City palaces Uncover Pu Yi’s secret deals as royal art & priceless calligraphy flowed out under watchful eyes

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Hand-to-hand combat, it is every soldiers greatest fear At the Army Combatives School in Fort Benning, Georgia, they teach soldiers how to fight to survive Teach them skills that are beyond UFC…skills that kill!

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: Trading in his city clothes and cell phone for a black hat and plain shirt, host Tevya goes off the grid into a world where technology is taboo and life is humble Mennonites live without modern conveniences, drive horse and buggies and worship in their own devout yet simple ways Can city-boy Tevya survive a cattle auction, farming by hand and a quilting circle?

programme.title: 属灵教室: 启示录研读-张永信牧师
programme.desc: 圣经最后的一卷启示录,常被信徒,甚至普世人类所注重。可惜的是,被误解和误用的情况却很普遍。解释启示录最大的问题,便是读者们对于此书卷的体裁所知甚少,以致不明白诠释启示录的方法。本节目倾重于对启示录体裁的阐释,让观众明白如何将方法论,应用在各有关的经文上。

programme.desc: 麦希真牧师:「我是八十三岁很老很老的基督工人,『还有末了的话』(林后13:11)要告诉你们。你们都是主要大用的基督工人,若稍为留心这些十分重要『末了的话』,也许有一点助益的。」麦希真牧师将《末了的话》分成八个部分共34个题目,此部为《踏实的差传》。

programme.title: 来!为这城祷告
programme.desc: 你们要为那城求平安,为那城祷告耶和华;因为那城得平安,你们也随著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 《天下华人唱出好诗歌大赛》大赛
programme.desc: 由影音使团、香港福音盛会、华福会香港区委会、以勒基金主办,创世电视首届「天下华人唱出好诗歌」大赛,冠军即将诞生。世上最美的声音,是生命重生的声音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位参加者,一年训练、成长、比并、同行,要成为祝福城市的好声音。

programme.title: 喜乐婆婆会客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子乔妈,人称「喜乐婆婆」,一生经历操练出一套喜乐心得,她更请来一众嘉宾好友,分享人生中大小风浪,靠著的是同出一辙的喜乐秘诀,在节目中娓娓道出那份属天的快乐。

programme.title: 「创世电视福音主日」-不由你不信之从灵界迷惑到真相大白
programme.desc: 「超阔银幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大众化的福音主题」,加上「诚意的款待」会产生极致的「福音体验」。奉主的名 带著权柄与邪灵争战。

programme.title: 灵修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透过诗歌安静心灵,从牧者及嘉宾的分享学习《圣经》中的真理,让观众由浅入深认识信仰,默想《圣经》教导。

programme.title: 来!为这城祷告
programme.desc: 你们要为那城求平安,为那城祷告耶和华;因为那城得平安,你们也随著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的宝藏
programme.desc: 摄制队走访美国、英国、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中国及亚洲等国家,访寻学者专家多年来从大地发掘的宝藏及科研成果,当中包括高山上经历大洪水形成的奇异化石;全球首卷手抄丝绸中文圣经;以色列铸造挪亚方舟金币场等。n一切一切的资料,让观众在欣赏地球的创造同时,见证上帝的奇妙创作及精密设计,从心感受

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人说,人生是一场戏,在人生的过程中,寻找有时、碰壁有时、迷失有时、觉醒有时,说真的,这些起承转合比真正的电影情节更精彩,每一个「你」,都是天父特别设计的人生剧本主角。 今天,我们的世界充满了末世风情,醉生梦死、迷失自我了结生命的悲剧每天上演,创世电视藉100个见证故事挽救生命,100位来自世界各地

programme.title: 如果还有明天5 我为上帝精彩过
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下错车,弄得满身伤痕、万劫不复,惟有祂并不介意我们的过去,愿意领我们走向美好的将来。《如果还有明天5我为上帝精彩过》,深入中国广西山区孤儿院,记录残障青年在信仰中找回尊严和盼望的故事。摄制队再远赴南半球,见证澳洲天生失明女歌手及轮椅上的妈妈,突破身体局限活出主爱无限;还有美国摘冠

programme.title: 吴宣伦博士-挪亚的日子逼近 主必快来专题讲座 教会被提与敌基督出现
programme.desc: 末世响起,各地天灾人祸越趋频繁,人心该当何处走?大灾难响起,人类有可逃之处吗?今集吴宣伦博士从《圣经》里深入浅出地探讨「教会被提」与「敌基督的出现」两者的关系,当中「七年大灾难」又怎样发生?原来其中有着密不可分的关系。

高朋满座#229粤
programme.desc: 亨借醉向高丽求婚，丽称若出现「大红花轿」便答应。突然电视上，出现一幕「大红花轿」片段，丽不支醉倒。翌日亨带著聘礼来到高家「提亲」，但醉醒的丽却拒绝承认而逃亡。亨以吃来发泄，庆教亨以「排场」来感动丽。

programme.title: 玉楼春#43粤普
programme.desc: 孙逊被赐自尽，孙玉楼伤心难过，自觉再无面目面对林少春，独自离去。柳三绝拜祭孙逊时遇到少春，劝少春去找玉楼，以免像自己一样悔不当初。少春到处寻找玉楼。皇上召见梁京冠，一人带著其贪墨罪证出现，梁京冠大惊。

programme.title: 方德证券独家呈现:交易现场粤 及 潮流生活志之玩转澳门有段古粤
阿妈教落食平D粤
programme.desc: 食素不一定要「菜炒菇」、「菇炒豆」，肥妈设计素食食谱，可做出「三杯鸡」及「黑椒鸡扒」！肥妈会怎样利用汁料及猴头菇、鸡髀菇的特性，令它们变成几可乱真的「鸡肉」？肥妈将一盒豆腐预先放进冰格，制成冰豆腐，连同木耳丝、冬菇、甘笋等放进汤煲中，加入豆瓣酱及陈醋，煲出一大碗「素酸辣汤」，开胃无比。肥妈准备了油面筋、水面筋，与马铃薯、番茄同煮，倒入咖喱酱及椰浆，煮出「椰汁咖喱斋」，随时比椰汁咖喱鸡更入味！

programme.title: 航向未来粤
programme.desc: 运输及物流局积极推动本港的海空联运，节目《航向未来》由星级艺员吴伟豪、郭柏妍担纲演出，并饰演初到海运前线的实习生，透过实况情节，介绍当局如何精准高效地协调货船泊进港口后，把船上货物经香港转运出海，继而运往世界各地，同时为国际航运业绿色减碳出力。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 头颈癌泛指发生于头颈多个位置的恶性肿瘤，以口腔癌与喉癌最常见。临床肿瘤科医生指吸烟、长期酗酒均会大幅推高患癌风险，并细说早期警号与诊治资讯。视网膜色素上皮分离是一种严重眼疾，不同年龄层的主要成因各异。眼科医生提醒，如突发出现视物变形或视力骤变，务要及早求医，否则恐有失明危机。不同成因的视网膜色素上皮分离治疗方法亦各异，留意医生详析治疗方案并带来预防建议。「睇𩠌食饭」，郑锦富示范「酸笋云耳炒牛腱」。

programme.title: LAW霸女神粤

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 二手名牌寄卖店突结业，东主疑拖欠款项并失联，事主讲述寄卖奢侈品与损失情况。夫妇于1998年购入物业，早前因市区重建计划而获赔偿部份金额，及后却被指并非完整业权持有人，要收回赔偿。原来该物业是「送契楼」，夫妇质疑当年律师有所疏忽。TVB台庆举行在即，这集搜罗拜神花絮；「中声」家族积极排舞，期待献上精彩演出。众艺员参与全民皆「乒」选拔，「队长」陈展鹏透露想培育女儿成为球手。另带来有助改善鼻敏感的资讯。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱．回家之三代同糖#72粤
programme.desc: 杨帆等为床上用品品牌物色娇小可爱女生任代言人，推广新款枕头。另一边厢，文谦的太太、女干探招积琦，又接到新的卧底任务与家人分离，甚至连儿子的入学面试也未能出席，文谦大感苦恼。范特栖与杨光惊见积琦竟在枕头代言人候选之列，认为积琦不应为工作牺牲家庭；文谦却支持爱妻实现当警察的梦想，并道出二人的相识经过。在范特栖与杨光鼓励下，文谦决定正视夫妻聚少离多的问题，并想到留住积琦的方法，惟瞬间改变主意……

programme.title: 保诚保险呈献：玫瑰战争#8粤PG
programme.desc: 绮云发现自己在《玫瑰》内的戏份被改成与菲雅瓜分，震怒拒拍；云生认为要以大局为重。绮云不甘影后之路屡屡受阻，其父黎叔扬言为她扫除障碍。片场发生连环事故，无双更一度被困火海。宝儿被无双得悉她仍在香港；无双误以为德龙欺骗宝儿感情，宝儿唯有向无双坦白选择留下的原因……安安收到神秘讯息，吓得向无双求助，并将关于子盈的一切悉数告知。《死亡揭露》开录，安安直指凤仪布局假装子盈自杀，凤仪现身反驳，两人各执一词……

programme.title: 丰隆旅游保险呈献：跟风旅行团粤
programme.desc: 如风学定赞美说话，然后走进曾创出千万浏览数字影片的甜品店，只因多位靓仔店员。如风视觉、手感获得满足，但味觉似乎……附近还有间亚洲排十五薄饼店，自设原始焗炉，就知即叫即焗有保证。店员推介芝士红辣椒、乌鱼子两款，某款据称是死前必要吃一次？圣水洞是青年人集中地，拍摄团队要试年轻玩意「漆弹射兔」减压，结果兔仔没怎么被染色，如风却犯了错要跪地求饶兼被围攻！如风私心推介，到星级名牌改装服饰店寻找「心头好」。

programme.desc: 小石受师父所托，要把事关金风细雨楼传承的玉匣子交给梦枕；小石去到细柳镇，六分半堂的人想抢匣子，幸得女侠温柔制止…观赏游行期间又有人想抢匣子，初到步时曾见面的愁飞救了小石，自此小石、温柔和愁飞一同上路…

阿妈教落食平D粤
programme.desc: 猪肉干、能量棒必需要花十元八块购入才能享用？肥妈表示在家都做得到！将喜爱的干果零食捞匀，加入蜜糖及麦芽糖，压实后放雪柜，便做好一大份能量棒。而做猪肉干最重要是买点带肥的猪踭肉，$50可做出几多？肥妈还分享「牛肉纸」食谱，只需将加上调味粉的牛肉放滚油炸便完成，绝对是「零难度」小食。零难度的还有滑溜的「豆腐蒸肉饼」，随时会直接滑入食道，食用时记得打醒十二分精神！

programme.title: 航向未来粤
programme.desc: 运输及物流局积极推动本港的海空联运，节目《航向未来》由星级艺员吴伟豪、郭柏妍担纲演出，并饰演初到海运前线的实习生，透过实况情节，介绍当局如何精准高效地协调货船泊进港口后，把船上货物经香港转运出海，继而运往世界各地，同时为国际航运业绿色减碳出力。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 糖尿病病人都可能有低血糖症？内分泌及糖尿科医生拆解个中原因。另外，低血糖症也有假？医生指要「笃手指」分辨真假，再寻找适当食物让血糖升回正常水平。医生更警告不要擅自停药，或会有甚么并发症？久坐与不良姿势或会引致「死臀综合症」，意指臀肌逐渐遗忘了如何收缩与发力。病症初期会以临床诊断为先，治疗主方向则以运动激活已休眠的肌肉，物理治疗师会亲自示范相关动作。「睇𩠌食饭」，傅季馨炮制「大闸蟹粉拌意大利面」。

programme.title: 甜心教室粤

programme.title: 利嘉阁地产45 周年真盘源特约：今日有楼睇粤 及 潮流生活志之玩转澳门有段古粤
programme.desc: 黄竹坑一个三房新盘，装修以简约为主，同时又要配合发展商原有家具，设计师如何处理？

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤
有理说得清粤 及 航向未来粤
programme.desc: 两位时事评论员屈颖妍、杨立门，同观众论尽天下事、国家事、香港事；大事小事，开门见山、言无不尽，《有理说得清》！

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱．回家之三代同糖#73粤
programme.desc: 龚喜遭电骗集团骗去巨款，报警后银行户口暂时被冻结。她本想向姐夫高修借钱，惟高修派冠一赴约，令她难以启齿。嘉冰答应暂代支付各项开支，并趁机教龚喜学习节俭美德。唐芯带二人到超市享用免费试食，却因与《当年好声音》对手MOMO狭路相逢惹出风波；龚喜与嘉冰到名店，打算以唐芯传授的奇招「免费」购置新衣，怎料再次横生枝节……得不偿失。连串悭钱计划失败，嘉冰开销大增，日常伙食亦成问题，唐芯再献悭钱妙计……

programme.title: 保诚保险呈献：玫瑰战争#9粤PG
programme.desc: 德龙往找无双，带来线索佐证安安所言非虚，二人决定联手追查真相。《玫瑰》开拍情欲戏，素希到片场向菲雅示威，菲雅带着不忿与德龙在镜头前激烈演出。云生着绮云设法令安安噤声。安安信任绮云，透露掌握子盈死亡真相的关键佐证片段，绮云提出收购；绮云派黎叔的手下冯志健与安安交收USB。安安遇上严重意外，USB辗转落入无双手中，无双看后震撼……另边厢，无双向绮云直言安安的意外是凤仪所为……

programme.title: 丰隆旅游保险呈献：跟风旅行团粤
programme.desc: 望远市场以高CP值美食见称，如风依网片路线扫街，却被新鲜鳕场蟹吸引，差点遗忘「揾食」任务！糖饼获评首选美食，如风深入地下室一探虚实。即叫即炸辣椒内有乾坤；幕后人员挑战劲辣无骨炸鸡，辣到手震！藉年糕排骨中和刺激感，但内里不含年糕，也非排骨？最后以抵食可乐饼作结，如风满足到带来恶搞表演……非一般「超市」充满惊喜，各款蔬果竟是造型公仔，番薯、粟米却是面包？饱肚后转战时尚服饰热点，如风示范「购物烧脂法」。

programme.title: 武则天#30粤普
programme.desc: 媚娘被囚掖庭，韦妃派人灭口；青梅竹马李牧闯狱救她。世民查其身分，李牧凭伪造背景过关，媚娘则开始追查逼宫疑点。

programme.title: 娱乐头条粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
programme.desc: 节目主要以当日的娱乐新闻作重点，让你瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈动态和最新消息，并以「娱乐大事件」、「抢闸头条」、「出炉猛料」等为主题作头条新闻式报道。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤 及 潮流生活志之玩转澳门有段古粤
骗中传奇#15粤
programme.desc: 经过一夜缠绵，玉麟及忠正变得恩爱异常。承康因请帖之事赶至守言家，忠正无情地指摘他，并让守言等人试饮「天下无双酒」。承康知道再也瞒骗不下，唯有说出「天下无双酒」之来历，众人均表同情，忠正亦由玉麟口中得知，承康为撮合他俩，尽了不少绵力，想尽办法取消试酒惜不成功。忠正于是运用骗术，使众人将分得之「天下无双酒」，暂存于木箱内，欲趁机挟酒私逃，免承康声誉受损。岂料其举动被黑衣人一一监视，忠正及顾井陷入险境。

programme.title: 李宁二零二六香港公开羽毛球锦标赛 汇丰世界羽联世界巡回赛超级500粤
programme.desc: 新一届「香港公开羽毛球锦标赛」，2026年11月17至22日在启德体艺馆举行。赛事云集来自廿多个国家及地区的二百多名羽坛好手参加，角逐各项单打与双打的冠军。TVB翡翠台带来关键阶段的比拼精华，跟观众一起欣赏高水准的羽毛球激战！

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 心脏科医生指心脏血管阻塞分为慢性与急性，除了依赖搭桥手术治疗，人体亦可能会透过「侧支循环」自建新供血渠道，绕过阻塞位置，留意医生详析相关资讯。香港滚轴溜冰小将李悦意、赵奭孜联同教练受访，分享登上世界巅峰的热血历程。两人自四、五岁已接触这运动，沉醉于个中带来的速度感，及挑战自我精神。她们分别在花式绕桩与速度过桩项目荣登「世一」，同对佳绩感到光荣和喜悦。「睇𩠌食饭」，Annie师傅示范「原粒豆豉鸡」。

programme.title: 甜心教室粤
programme.desc: 阮政峰自信地跟陈华鑫(金金)分享心得，认为出色甜品师必须将「味觉」和「嗅觉」训练到极致。古嘉俊(古Sir)提议两人来个「嗅觉」大测试，两人能否成功通过？古Sir示范「柚子焦糖冧酒牛奶朱古力」，皆因柚子和焦糖是上佳配搭，但煮焦糖要留意甚么？他还讲解今次做朱古力馅为何弃用鱼胶粉？两位「同学仔」在制作「朱古力外壳」时，古Sir懊恼大叹「十级混乱」，情况有多狼狈？他又无奈劝喻金金从「幼儿班」重新学起！

programme.title: 大帅哥#7粤PG
programme.desc: 天娇自小在妓院长大，她埋怨狄奇不让为人妻的她一起共患难，狄奇感动，带她走时遭妓院老板根本英俊刁难。罗义到歌厅接艾妞回大帅府，艾妞打算重投大同怀抱而拒绝，岂料大同已把她忘记。罗义为救艾妞中刀，艾妞自责红颜祸水。落芦将少帅带回大帅府，仍不肯做狄奇军师，狄奇放出诱饵令他乖乖留下。翌晨，落芦指出升威镇的防守问题，唤醒狄奇要去先根的禄丰镇抢地盘。此时细龟、佘南为瓜分禄丰镇而争拗，狄奇出现要分一杯羮，结果……

programme.title: 高朋满座#231粤
programme.desc: 花向义提出分手，义却仍不知自己错在那里，更要根打探。根发现花自分手后松口气，义摸不著头脑。义到按摩椅专门店哄花，但花却不断表示心意已决。此时，三妗婆突然来访，催促二人婚期，他们唯有支吾而对。

programme.title: 说英雄谁是英雄#2粤普PG
programme.desc: 小石、愁飞和温柔来到码头，想从水路前进，巧遇船上的雷纯，四人结交相谈甚欢。三人下船后，愁飞借词把温柔气走，来到苦水铺，见到苏梦枕，不巧他正被六分半堂埋伏袭击，小石和愁飞出手相助击退敌人，三人结为好友。

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 热血军检
programme.desc: 【安普贤携手曹宝儿，成最强军检察官搭档！！】以韩国军事法庭为背景，为了各自目的而成为军检察官，都培万只想往上爬达成复仇目标，车友仁出身军法世家，为替父母讨回公道而回到军中。当军中黑暗势力浮上台面，他们选择不再服从命令，而是直面权力、揭露真相。在正义与复仇之间，两人逐步找回真正的信念，也点燃危险又炙热的同盟关系，从对立到并肩作战的故事。

programme.title: 南风知我意
programme.desc: 【《莲花楼》成毅在搭张予曦，再现《与君歌》绝美默契！！】药物研发员傅云深与外科医生朱旧至偏乡进行人道医疗救援，两人从误解到经历生死危机而两情相悦，彼此还不及坦承心意就遭逢巨变，从此断绝联系。一年后的重逢，面对傅云深的刁难与变化，朱旧坚韧及乐观并不离不弃的守候，陪他度过每个春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 吹吧微风
programme.desc: 【千亿遗产考验林智妍沦落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一场跨越南北的失散命运，意外揭开千亿财产背后的血缘骗局。脱北女孩微风重返南韩，与多年不见的初恋律师长高重逢，却被卷入豪门争产与身世之谜。冒名孙女设局夺产，谎言层层堆叠，亲情逐渐崩裂；长高的母亲强势介入，以门第与前途逼迫儿子放弃真爱。当真相一一曝光，有人为贪念付出惨痛代价，有人失去一切。被牺牲的爱情，是否还能在命运翻转后，迎来真正的团圆？

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破脸！命运抓弄下的同居奇迹】一场毁灭性的家庭变故，让原本关系紧绷的离婚婆婆、媳妇与小姑，命运交织地被迫同住在一个屋簷下。撕下以往的对立标签，三个性格迥异、伤痕累累的女人在满是摩擦与冲突的日常中，渐渐看清彼此的脆弱。她们相互扶持、携手抵御人生的逆境风浪，最终走出阴霾，共筑出比血缘更坚固的暖心情谊！

programme.title: 金装律师
programme.desc: 【改编人气美国影集，张东健×朴炯植联手成为法律界黄金拍档！！】头脑聪明，拥有过目不忘天才能力的高延宇，却因家境关系却步成为律师。混进了律师事务所遇上韩国顶级资深律师崔江锡。随著事件发生与时间相处成为黄金拍档，崔江锡要如何亦师亦友的带著没有正式念过大学也只是菜鸟律师的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 汉摩拉比小姐
programme.desc: 【高雅罗×金明洙×成东镒，三人三色法官个性，寻找法庭正义！！】三位个性截然不同的法官，在现实与理想间的挣扎与选择。热血直率的新任法官及冷静理性的资深法官同事。每一场审判，都是对人性与制度的考验。在案件背后，他们不只判案，更在学习如何面对自己心中的「正义」。

programme.title: 风起西州
programme.desc: 【《风起霓裳》最新续作！！许魏洲、古力娜扎续夫妻情缘，琴瑟和鸣的婚后生活及事业新考验！！】制衣才女库狄琉璃与裴行俭婚后面对大长公主的屡次使计刁难，琉璃聪慧应对，化险为夷。裴行俭因意外被贬远赴西州上任，夫妻携手同心，琉璃发挥自己的长才，传授西州百姓制衣技巧。裴行俭则守护西州百姓经济富足、安居乐业。

programme.title: 金装律师
programme.desc: 【改编人气美国影集，张东健×朴炯植联手成为法律界黄金拍档！！】头脑聪明，拥有过目不忘天才能力的高延宇，却因家境关系却步成为律师。混进了律师事务所遇上韩国顶级资深律师崔江锡。随著事件发生与时间相处成为黄金拍档，崔江锡要如何亦师亦友的带著没有正式念过大学也只是菜鸟律师的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 时光之城
programme.desc: 【横跨两国人气演员的偶像剧，张哲瀚携手朴敏英初尝试爱情罗曼史！！】乐观积极的元气少女许真，在前往盖亚影视应征时撞见了当红炸子鸡顾持钧被前女友拒绝的场面。不希望丢脸的事情曝光的顾持钧则从中作梗想赶走许真，却阴错阳差的在盖亚集团二公子林晋修的帮助下，反而成为了顾持钧的助理。朝夕相处、情愫蔓延，却同时卷入了集团的阴谋，两人要如何逃出危机，让有情人终成眷属呢?

programme.title: 汉摩拉比小姐

programme.title: 夫妇的世界
programme.desc: 【闺蜜包庇老公偷吃！看正宫血洗渣男小三】医院副院长池善雨拥有令人羡慕的完美生活，却因一根神秘发丝，惊觉导演丈夫早已出轨富家千金，且身边挚友全都是帮忙隐瞒的帮凶。面对爱情与友情的双重背叛，彻底心碎的她不再隐忍，决心化身复仇女神。她智商在线地精心设局，利用财产、孩子与社会地位作为筹码，与丈夫展开一场玉石俱焚的心理战与利益争夺，将虚伪的婚姻面具狠狠撕碎。

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 热血军检(完)
programme.desc: 【安普贤携手曹宝儿，成最强军检察官搭档！！】以韩国军事法庭为背景，为了各自目的而成为军检察官，都培万只想往上爬达成复仇目标，车友仁出身军法世家，为替父母讨回公道而回到军中。当军中黑暗势力浮上台面，他们选择不再服从命令，而是直面权力、揭露真相。在正义与复仇之间，两人逐步找回真正的信念，也点燃危险又炙热的同盟关系，从对立到并肩作战的故事。

programme.title: 南风知我意
programme.desc: 【《莲花楼》成毅在搭张予曦，再现《与君歌》绝美默契！！】药物研发员傅云深与外科医生朱旧至偏乡进行人道医疗救援，两人从误解到经历生死危机而两情相悦，彼此还不及坦承心意就遭逢巨变，从此断绝联系。一年后的重逢，面对傅云深的刁难与变化，朱旧坚韧及乐观并不离不弃的守候，陪他度过每个春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 吹吧微风
programme.desc: 【千亿遗产考验林智妍沦落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一场跨越南北的失散命运，意外揭开千亿财产背后的血缘骗局。脱北女孩微风重返南韩，与多年不见的初恋律师长高重逢，却被卷入豪门争产与身世之谜。冒名孙女设局夺产，谎言层层堆叠，亲情逐渐崩裂；长高的母亲强势介入，以门第与前途逼迫儿子放弃真爱。当真相一一曝光，有人为贪念付出惨痛代价，有人失去一切。被牺牲的爱情，是否还能在命运翻转后，迎来真正的团圆？

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破脸！命运抓弄下的同居奇迹】一场毁灭性的家庭变故，让原本关系紧绷的离婚婆婆、媳妇与小姑，命运交织地被迫同住在一个屋簷下。撕下以往的对立标签，三个性格迥异、伤痕累累的女人在满是摩擦与冲突的日常中，渐渐看清彼此的脆弱。她们相互扶持、携手抵御人生的逆境风浪，最终走出阴霾，共筑出比血缘更坚固的暖心情谊！

programme.title: 金装律师
programme.desc: 【改编人气美国影集，张东健×朴炯植联手成为法律界黄金拍档！！】头脑聪明，拥有过目不忘天才能力的高延宇，却因家境关系却步成为律师。混进了律师事务所遇上韩国顶级资深律师崔江锡。随著事件发生与时间相处成为黄金拍档，崔江锡要如何亦师亦友的带著没有正式念过大学也只是菜鸟律师的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 汉摩拉比小姐
programme.desc: 【高雅罗×金明洙×成东镒，三人三色法官个性，寻找法庭正义！！】三位个性截然不同的法官，在现实与理想间的挣扎与选择。热血直率的新任法官及冷静理性的资深法官同事。每一场审判，都是对人性与制度的考验。在案件背后，他们不只判案，更在学习如何面对自己心中的「正义」。

programme.title: 风起西州
programme.desc: 【《风起霓裳》最新续作！！许魏洲、古力娜扎续夫妻情缘，琴瑟和鸣的婚后生活及事业新考验！！】制衣才女库狄琉璃与裴行俭婚后面对大长公主的屡次使计刁难，琉璃聪慧应对，化险为夷。裴行俭因意外被贬远赴西州上任，夫妻携手同心，琉璃发挥自己的长才，传授西州百姓制衣技巧。裴行俭则守护西州百姓经济富足、安居乐业。

programme.title: 时光之城
programme.desc: 【横跨两国人气演员的偶像剧，张哲瀚携手朴敏英初尝试爱情罗曼史！！】乐观积极的元气少女许真，在前往盖亚影视应征时撞见了当红炸子鸡顾持钧被前女友拒绝的场面。不希望丢脸的事情曝光的顾持钧则从中作梗想赶走许真，却阴错阳差的在盖亚集团二公子林晋修的帮助下，反而成为了顾持钧的助理。朝夕相处、情愫蔓延，却同时卷入了集团的阴谋，两人要如何逃出危机，让有情人终成眷属呢?

programme.desc: 【横跨两国人气演员的偶像剧，张哲瀚携手朴敏英初尝试爱情罗曼史！！】乐观积极的元气少女许真，在前往盖亚影视应征时撞见了当红炸子鸡顾持钧被前女友拒绝的场面。不希望丢脸的事情曝光的顾持钧则从中作梗想赶走许真，却阴错阳差的在盖亚集团二公子林晋修的帮助下，反而成为了顾持钧的助理。朝夕相处、情愫蔓延，却同时卷入了集团的阴谋，两人要如何逃出危机，让有情人终成眷属呢?

programme.title: 汉摩拉比小姐
programme.desc: 【高雅罗×金明洙×成东镒，三人三色法官个性，寻找法庭正义！！】三位个性截然不同的法官，在现实与理想间的挣扎与选择。热血直率的新任法官及冷静理性的资深法官同事。每一场审判，都是对人性与制度的考验。在案件背后，他们不只判案，更在学习如何面对自己心中的「正义」。

programme.title: Life Feels Good
programme.desc: The true story of Mateusz, a man suffering from cerebral palsy, who in his early childhood had been diagnosed as a retard with no contact with the outside world. After twenty-five years it turned out that he was a perfectly normal and intelligent person.

programme.title: Turkish For Beginners
programme.desc: Could things be worse? While on a vacation she never wanted, Lena’s plane crashes on a remote Andaman island. Now she’s stranded with a sexy Turk, his religious sister and a stuttering Greek

programme.title: Bermuda Triangle North Sea
programme.desc: Ships disappearing, wind farms collapsing, flocks of seagulls falling from the sky - what does the giant energy firm have to do with the mysterious calamities in the North Sea? Tom, a pilot, and Marie, the energy firm’s PR chief, uncover a horrible truth.

programme.title: Djam
programme.desc: Djam, a bold young Greek woman, travels to Istanbul to look for an engine part for her uncle’s boat. She meets a stranded and penniless Avril, who is a volunteer for Syrian refugees. Together, they embark on a lively, music-filled journey to Mytilene.

programme.title: Paris La Blanche
programme.desc: In this parable of migration, Rekia, 70 years-old, leaves Kabylie for Paris to fetch her husband, Nour, back home. Nour has been sustaining the family from abroad for 40 years. Finding help in new friends, she finds Nour but he is a changed man.

programme.title: Empty Nets
programme.desc: Amir loves Narges and Narges loves Amir. But their hopes and dreams for a life together collide head on with the web of tradition, corruption, and social hierarchy that continues to rule over the lives of a new generation in Iran.

programme.title: Mountain Woman
programme.desc: When famine overruns a small Japanese village, Rin must leave the village in order to protect her father accused of theft. Rin heads deep into Mt. Hayachin, and crosses the forbidden mountain god's shrine, where the goddess of thieves is said to dwell.

programme.title: Lemonade
programme.desc: Mara, a young Romanian mother, is a caretaker in the US on a temporary visa. Life seemed perfect after she got married and brought her son over. However, she faces abuses of power from the officer in her green card process, who seeks to exploit her plight.

programme.title: Life Feels Good

programme.title: Sarah Kohr: Cement
programme.desc: After waking in a hospital with no memory, Sarah Kohr is accused of shooting an innocent man following a violent accident. Determined to clear her name, she sets out to uncover the truth of what really happened that night.

programme.title: Heavenly Nomadic
programme.desc: A family of nomads dwelling high in the mountains of Kyrgyzstan doesn't need any of the conveniences of modern civilization in order to be happy. But progress is creeping into their lives regardless, destroying legends and traditions as it comes.

programme.title: For Night Will Come
programme.desc: The Feral family plans to blend in when they move into a new neighbourhood. But their son is no ordinary teenager. When he gets closer to his new neighbour, his thirst for blood grows and his difference becomes impossible to hide.

programme.title: In Other Circumstances: Death of a Stalker
programme.desc: What if everyone believed you were a killer? After a man threatening her son is found dead with her gun, Detective Jana Winter becomes the prime suspect. To clear her name, she must confront a mastermind who knows her every fear.

programme.title: Lightning-Struck
programme.desc: At her wedding in the Auvergne mountains, Lucie survives a lightning strike that kills her husband but leaves her with the ability to remember every moment of her life. At a reunion two years later, the survivors are targeted by a mysterious killer.

programme.desc: From snails called David to Daddy Spider Longlegs', the funny animals talk about all things creepy and crawly.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Bedroom

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Sleeping Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels have had an exhausting morning playing. After their milk they can have their nap. Lovely...but Tag can't sleep! Don't worry, Duggee can help, he has his Sleeping Badge and can offer a few tricks to get to sleep.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Master of Puppets

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Beach Day
programme.desc: Maisy and her friends enjoy a sunny beach day and make a sandcastle

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Dentist

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Cranberries
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the bouncing and singing Cranberries!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Pear

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Wishing Tree

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Grape Kids' Super Camp
programme.desc: Supertato shows the Grape Kids how to camp Supertato-style, but Evil Pea arrives and wows them with her ice camping. Before long, the Grape Kids need to be rescued by Supertato.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Hidey Hup
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa­Laa and Po drive to the Hidey Hup in the Tubby Car. They enjoy going on the Tubby Bouncy, the Tubby Uppy Downy, the Tubby Spinny and the Tubby Slidey.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S04 - Sheep

First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that 'finding their talents' means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Transport Badge

programme.title: Love without End(1961)
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin...

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: Two royal brothers are separated as babies after a traitorous general usurps the throne. Raised apart, one within Shaolin Temple and the other by a noble lord, they grow into formidable martial artists. When destiny reunites them, the brothers must combine their deadly kung fu styles to overthrow the tyrant and avenge their fallen empire.

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: Young Long Jian Fei, a martial arts novice, is adopted by the Fire Spirit Demon who taught him the powerful Buddha's Palm, turning Long into a martial arts master. Long is tasked by the Fire Spirit Demon to takes revenge for his master, and this soon unleashes a storm upon the martial arts world...

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the ‘Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner. When his best friend, Bobby begins investigating recent murder cases committed by Kam, he discovers that the mastermind behind these cases is actually his superintendent.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wong's caught in the Mong's territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Ping's limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Wealthy heir Ping Chien Jen spurns the family business for a travel agency with his girlfriend Su Yung Lan. While they are hosting visitors from Hong Kong, a student falls for Chien Jen, sparking tension. Consumed by jealousy, Yung Lan storms off, and the student crashes her car after learning of his engagement. Misunderstandings are eventually cleared, and happiness follows.

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: Qing enforcer Luo Yi Hu murders rebel Chen Gui, forcing his wife and daughter Xiao Wei to flee to Guang Long Town. There, mischievous Jia Yu discovers his master's identity as a rebel while helping Xiao Wei. After his loved ones and mentor are killed, Jia Yu sheds his playful ways and seeks vengeance, facing the Qing forces in a final battle.

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: Qing enforcer Luo Yi Hu murders rebel Chen Gui, forcing his wife and daughter Xiao Wei to flee to Guang Long Town. There, mischievous Jia Yu discovers his master's identity as a rebel while helping Xiao Wei. After his loved ones and mentor are killed, Jia Yu sheds his playful ways and seeks vengeance, facing the Qing forces in a final battle.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: Three rookie constables refuse to collude with corrupt officials, making themselves targets of a deadly conspiracy. After losing comrades and witnessing the abuse of power, they abandon all hope of justice. Determined to avenge the fallen, they launch a bloody assault on the corrupt forces in a desperate fight for justice.

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley. A team of swordswomen led by Liu wants to get their hands on the treasures before the bandits, but both parties will have to contend with the wandering swordsman Chou for them...

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Tales of a Eunuch
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao inadvertently enters the palace and unexpectedly befriends Emperor Kang Xi, whilst covertly serving rebels seeking the sacred “Sutra of Forty-Two Chapters”. Caught between rival factions when the Emperor seeks it too, Xiao Bao must rely on his quick wit and cunning to survive the perilous court and evade danger.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: A young swordswoman Fang Ying Qi sets out to join the Flying Dragon Clan in their defense against the invading Jin forces. Fang also intends to avenge the murder of her parents by bandit leader Han 20 years ago. Han has since taken on a false identity as a member of the Flying Dragon Clan and Fang must rely on her deadly sword skills to stop Han.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense...

programme.title: Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge her mother's death-a lie told by Li. The truth is revealed when she sees her mother alive by chance.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Carefree drifters Meng Gang and Tie Hu discover their purpose after meeting the revolutionary leader, Wan Tai. With the help of Meng Gang's girlfriend, they infiltrate a warlord camp to seize weapons for the revolutionary cause. Following a fierce battle, all three make the ultimate sacrifice, becoming the "Anonymous Heroes" of the revolution.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called “Five Poison Web”, spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his army's help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again...

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: Young swordsman Shen Bing Yi is appointed leader of the "Sun and Moon" secret society, sworn to take down a traitorous general conspiring with foreign invaders. While fighting for his nation, he captures the hearts of a spirited female warrior and two beautiful Uyghur princesses, leaving him caught between his duty and their devotion.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies...

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather’s fortune with one condition – he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: Ten years ago, the ambitious Lord Conqueror sought a prophecy from the Mystic Soothsayer. Told that only two boys named “Wind” and “Cloud” could help him dominate the martial world, he took them as disciples. Though his ambition is fulfilled, the prophecy takes an unexpected turn, unleashing a catastrophe that changes the jianghu forever.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie becomes a night guard at an abandoned building. Hours after their shift change, the previous guard is found murdered in a locked room, making Wang the prime suspect. As eerie events unfold, three vengeful ghosts appear and reveal a revenge plot. With misfortune piling up, is it fate or a curse?

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur…

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him…

programme.title: Face to Face

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian’s daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond…

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend. Both are discovered by Danny Lee, a handsome young explorer who brings the odd couple back to Hong Kong, where Evelyne

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Furious Attack
programme.desc: Ex-special forces operative Lung infiltrates a lawless cross-border crime compound after his reporter daughter, On Sum, goes missing while investigating it. When he discovers she is caught in a larger conspiracy, an enraged Lung fights his way through the criminal forces, determined to expose the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: The Mad Monk (1993)
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: IDC agent Jon survives a mission where his entire team is betrayed by their superior, Sean, leaving him with a life-threatening injury. Travelling to Malaysia to find his long-lost brother, he is drawn into a kidnapping case, only to discover his brother is involved, and Sean is the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: IDC agent Jon survives a mission where his entire team is betrayed by their superior, Sean, leaving him with a life-threatening injury. Travelling to Malaysia to find his long-lost brother, he is drawn into a kidnapping case, only to discover his brother is involved, and Sean is the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man’s matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation…

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father’s land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous “Gang Trio” is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three “Rob-B-Hood” must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.desc: Taoist priest Yat Mei and his disciples live in a remote village until Sister Maria restores an abandoned church, awakening a long-dormant vampire missionary. As panic spreads and Taoist exorcism fails, Yat Mei joins forces with a Western priest, combining Eastern and Western powers to battle evil.

In fact the ‘Jack’ is a sneaky little character dead set on taking his revenge on Scare School for being locked away all these years.. The Jack first hypnotizes Jimmy, and then other Deedstown kids before taking his little army to Scare School in order to confront Alder &amp; Dash. Will Casper manage to trap the Jack and get Jimmy out of danger? Casper Me

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Fly-A-Long Unburied Treasure
programme.desc: When the Dews' Glitter Guide, Willow comes to check on the Dews’ progress, they feel like they’re failing to impress her, until Lola gets locked out of the apartment during a game of Hide-and-Seek and Dews work together to get her back inside. When the Dew Drops discover a time capsule in the park, they set out to find the mystery owner.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Tooth on the Loose That Thing You Dew
programme.desc: When Phoebe convinces the Tooth Fairy to visit before Marcus has actually lost his tooth, the Dew Drops do everything in their power to make sure the tooth is out before she arrives! The Dews decide to hold a concert in the park for their animal friends, but can’t find the time to practice.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - She Said, She Said Starfish
programme.desc: When one of Rikki’s plants won't sing, Pixie and Juniper both tell their varying recollections of why the plant is suddenly silent. Kelp, Scallop, and Cruz have always thought that starfish did nothing but laze about; but as they go about their day, the starfish goes through his own routine, completely unbeknownst to everyone else.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Leroy’s Caterpillar Lost Spark
programme.desc: Leroy must learn to let go when his caterpillar friend turns into a butterfly. When Pixie loses her spark, Kelp and Juniper look for the plant they think will cure her. Meanwhile Pixie wonders whether she can be cured at all!

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - As the Diaper Changes
programme.desc: When Grandma Templeton comes to stay, she forces Boss Baby into Tim's room but they struggle to be roommates, and meanwhile, Baby Corp's new CEO trusts Boss Baby with the new Stinkless Serum

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Family On The Edge
programme.desc: When Dagur comes to Dragon's Edge looking for Heather, Hiccup tries to keep the two siblings apart by teaching Dagur the art of Dragon Riding.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Dawn Of The Broods Part 1 & Part 2
programme.desc: Grug convinces The Croods to go on vacation, and they find a new family, The Broods, who live in a solitary utopia too good to be trueThe Croods must escape and warn Ahhh! Valley before it's too late.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S2 - Queen of the CastleTruth or Dare
programme.desc: Poppy attempts to complete her Dad’s abandoned plans for the greatest sand castle of all time. Unfortunately, she didn’t take the tides into consideration. Now she’s in a battle with the ocean to preserve the precious castle!When playing truth or dare, Biggie always chooses truth. But when he notices that this makes the game less fun for his friends, he strives to become the sort of Troll who could pull off a dare.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Night of the Frodarg
programme.desc: On a dark and stormy night, Tim's fears of a local legend and Boss Baby's fear of a PuppyCo agent force the brothers to unite to stay safe as the house is infiltrated

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Fugitive's Day Out
programme.desc: Boss Baby is framed for leaking info about the Stinkless Serum to PuppyCo and must flee on the run via Errand Day with the family

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Plushythingy
programme.desc: When Frederic Estes creates the cutest plushy ever that is the hottest toy in town, the field team must destroy the last remaining one but are powerless against its cuteness

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Picture Perfect
programme.desc: Tim and Boss Baby want to bond with Dad by recreating a perfect "Dudes Weekend' camping trip, culminating in a photo opp, but everything seems to go wrong

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Play It Again, Tim
programme.desc: When Tim is forced to take piano lessons, he actually enjoys them and Boss Baby realizes that Tim is being brainwashed by his piano teacher, slowly turning Tim into an old man

programme.title: The Adventures Of Rocky And Bullwinkle S1 - Almost Famoose: Chapter One
programme.desc: When Rocky and Bullwinkle damage the largest birdbath in the world, they set out on a musical adventure to put on a benefit concert and raise the money needed to restore the birdbath.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Crimson And Clover
programme.desc: Clover's wild, party-girl twin sister Crimson visits and King Julien is instantly smitten.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Pineapple Of My Eye
programme.desc: Masikura tricks King Julien into believing that a pineapple contains all the souls and wisdom of the previous Julien Kings.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Podlings Dumpster Dining
programme.desc: Oh's family reunion ends up turning into a disastrous family Tip and Oh secretly turn Lucy's craft store into a trendy new Boovian restaurant.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Boy Boy Girl Band Lords And Lazers
programme.desc: Tip and Oh try sneaking into a concert but almost destroy Human-Boov relations forever; K-Trong invites Tip and Oh to a make-believe game weekend.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Apok-ta-pokalypse Now Part 1
programme.desc: As the Dragon Knights prepare to battle for the weapons and control of Tikal, Mastodon attempts to teach Po how to access storm powers to use in the fight. Blade comes face to face with Klaus and Veruca.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Apok-ta-pokalypse Now Part 2
programme.desc: The team heads into a final confrontation for the weapons that not only threatens Tikal, but their lives. And Po must share hero duties with Mastodon.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - The Trial of Mr. Ping
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents—her mom. And somehow, Po finds himself in a chess tournament against the Queen of Englan

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Fam Farm Fun Fest
programme.desc: Believing he doesn't fit in on the farm, Chunky (aided by the other pets) leaves home to follow the distant call of another death cat. The kids set off to bring him back home. Note: Gran narrates the story.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - It's an Under-ful Life
programme.desc: "(Happens concurrent with events of previous episode) Grug accidentally reveals a subterranean cave beneath the treehouse. When Phil can't convince Hope, Grug, and Ugga that the treehouse is more impressive than the new cave, he sets out to destroy the cave."

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Alphabout
programme.desc: Trained by her parents, Eep competes in Alphafight-- a tournament where the animal kingdom fights to determine the dominant species. But when Eep learns that a human winning could upset the balance of nature, she must choose between winning to make her parents proud, and losing to protect the other animals.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Fun on the Autobahn
programme.desc: The search for the Incineration Day tech continues and Frostee thinks he’s finally figured out who’s behind the whole thing: his little sister, Sissy! Unfortunately, his theory is quickly debunked when Sissy and his moms are kidnapped by the actual bad guys – culminating in an epic race down the Autobahn to save Frostee’s family!

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Detonation
programme.desc: Cisco’s been kidnapped! The team scrambles to get him back, but Tony and Echo disagree on the best plan of action.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Meltdown
programme.desc: The team is reunited, but now they must race against the clock to stop Dann from setting off an explosion that will melt the polar ice caps and send the world into a new Ice Age.

programme.title: 布袋小和尚第11集
programme.desc: 说趣事․悟禅理․善能量以生动易懂的品德道理为主旨，精采呈现一部老少皆宜、有趣感人的禅理动画作品。《布袋小和尚》是中国大陆首部为孩子原创制作的禅意动画片。《布袋小和尚》以弥勒佛化身的布袋和尚为原型，以奉化雪窦寺为故事发生地，讲述一个逍遥自在、无拘无束、笑口常开的大肚弥勒小和尚，和他的伙伴小布袋、吉祥鸟，被委以修建庙宇的重任。在重建庙宇的过程中，布袋小和尚遇到了各种稀奇古怪、啼笑皆非的事情，小和尚运用他的聪明才智和神奇布袋，扬善惩恶，帮助百姓克服困难，用爱心温暖人间。剧情轻松有趣又感人，将中华传统美德融入其中，使得教育与娱乐相结合，教导少年儿童做好事、说好话、存好心等行为道德，在笑中体会道德的光芒

programme.desc: 说趣事․悟禅理․善能量以生动易懂的品德道理为主旨，精采呈现一部老少皆宜、有趣感人的禅理动画作品。《布袋小和尚》是中国大陆首部为孩子原创制作的禅意动画片。《布袋小和尚》以弥勒佛化身的布袋和尚为原型，以奉化雪窦寺为故事发生地，讲述一个逍遥自在、无拘无束、笑口常开的大肚弥勒小和尚，和他的伙伴小布袋、吉祥鸟，被委以修建庙宇的重任。在重建庙宇的过程中，布袋小和尚遇到了各种稀奇古怪、啼笑皆非的事情，小和尚运用他的聪明才智和神奇布袋，扬善惩恶，帮助百姓克服困难，用爱心温暖人间。剧情轻松有趣又感人，将中华传统美德融入其中，使得教育与娱乐相结合，教导少年儿童做好事、说好话、存好心等行为道德，在笑中体会道德的光芒

programme.title: 青春进化论第107集
programme.desc: 在全球一片鼓励创新创业的风潮下，台湾未来的发展要有竞争力，即需要不断的创新，让年轻人有更多机会实现想法及创意，不仅是在协助青年圆梦，更是在打造国家的未来。节目中创业者分享创业甘苦谈，创业时面临的心理挣扎，以及如何克服困难，坚持理想，继续走下去。【青年创ya家】主持人曾宝仪打破传统一问一答的制式访问，以如同家人、朋友间的聊天谈心，让各种你想得到的、想不到的青年创ya家，抛开紧张与包袱，轻松自在地分享自己的「青春进化论」。

programme.title: 欢乐家长群第9集
programme.desc: 编剧刘向上日常时间安排相对自由，在家里负责儿子果宁、女儿果宝的教育陪护，妻子戴静选择在薪酬较高的外地公司打拼。刘向上一家因为孩子开学而与朋友、邻居及其他学生家长成为群友，面对各种突发状况的新手家长们和鬼马精灵的孩子们共同迎接教育新课堂、人生新起点的故事。

programme.desc: 说趣事․悟禅理․善能量以生动易懂的品德道理为主旨，精采呈现一部老少皆宜、有趣感人的禅理动画作品。《布袋小和尚》是中国大陆首部为孩子原创制作的禅意动画片。《布袋小和尚》以弥勒佛化身的布袋和尚为原型，以奉化雪窦寺为故事发生地，讲述一个逍遥自在、无拘无束、笑口常开的大肚弥勒小和尚，和他的伙伴小布袋、吉祥鸟，被委以修建庙宇的重任。在重建庙宇的过程中，布袋小和尚遇到了各种稀奇古怪、啼笑皆非的事情，小和尚运用他的聪明才智和神奇布袋，扬善惩恶，帮助百姓克服困难，用爱心温暖人间。剧情轻松有趣又感人，将中华传统美德融入其中，使得教育与娱乐相结合，教导少年儿童做好事、说好话、存好心等行为道德，在笑中体会道德的光芒

programme.title: 热海恋歌第26集
programme.desc: 父母亲早逝的英雄，从小就住在西螺的大舅家。一次乡里冲突，英雄和换帖兄弟添财离家北上，进入温泉乡~北投，当起限时专送的机车小弟。在北投，他遇见今生唯一的挚爱秀秀。拥有天生音乐才华的他，最初学习各种乐器只是为了讨秀秀欢心，最后却因此成为名扬北投的「春风」那卡西乐团乐手。可惜两人纯真的恋情，却遭秀秀的养父所反对，英雄却不放弃；纵使在得知秀秀已与日本商人白原订婚之后，英雄仍不死心，继续穿梭在温泉乡崎岖的巷道与繁华的酒宴间，弹著为秀秀所谱写的未完成歌曲，无畏地向全世界宣誓，他要倾尽一生的光阴来爱秀秀…。在秀秀与白元的婚礼上，英雄冲到美川阁，想带秀秀远走高飞！毕竟深爱著英雄的秀秀，身著婚纱、不顾一切坐上他

programme.title: 幸福的起点第18集
programme.desc: 林雅美从小活泼聪明，林父身体不好，雅美从十岁开始学做生意，很快地展现她做生意的天赋，雅美是米行的超级业务员，同时也是四位妹妹的好大姊，不管有什么事情，天塌下来，总有大姊撑著。 雅美能干又漂亮，亭亭玉立正是适婚年纪，不过碾米厂家业全仰赖雅美，雅美根本无意出嫁。林父林母紧张，就像米一样，老米在市场上是没有竞争力的。父母积极地为雅美安排相亲，雅美体贴父母的心意，答应了相亲。不过雅美有个但书，她无论如何不要嫁给做生意的人，她已经厌倦了做生意的忙碌，如果真要进入婚姻，她只想要找一个老老实实的上班族。

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第61集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 映照人生第506集
programme.desc: 印尼，是个超过两亿人口的东南亚大国，贫富差距极大，且语言文化种族差异均大。由印尼大爱台制作的「映照人生」，报导当地各面向的社会议题，从2010年起逐年获奖，被誉为是印尼正面纪录片的先驱之一。 制作团队都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地观点，对印尼社会做深度观察，发现问题，报导当事人如何解决或面对，制作出一系列感人且启发人心的故事，传达以人道为关怀精神的节目内容。 本节目记录著印尼底层的人们，每个勇敢迎向苦难与希望的故事；也带领观众看见，这个世界的黑暗角落，因为人性的光辉，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 大爱午安新闻 LIVE

programme.title: 幸福的起点第18集
programme.desc: 林雅美从小活泼聪明，林父身体不好，雅美从十岁开始学做生意，很快地展现她做生意的天赋，雅美是米行的超级业务员，同时也是四位妹妹的好大姊，不管有什么事情，天塌下来，总有大姊撑著。 雅美能干又漂亮，亭亭玉立正是适婚年纪，不过碾米厂家业全仰赖雅美，雅美根本无意出嫁。林父林母紧张，就像米一样，老米在市场上是没有竞争力的。父母积极地为雅美安排相亲，雅美体贴父母的心意，答应了相亲。不过雅美有个但书，她无论如何不要嫁给做生意的人，她已经厌倦了做生意的忙碌，如果真要进入婚姻，她只想要找一个老老实实的上班族。

programme.title: 风月同天第35集

programme.desc: 林雅美从小活泼聪明，林父身体不好，雅美从十岁开始学做生意，很快地展现她做生意的天赋，雅美是米行的超级业务员，同时也是四位妹妹的好大姊，不管有什么事情，天塌下来，总有大姊撑著。 雅美能干又漂亮，亭亭玉立正是适婚年纪，不过碾米厂家业全仰赖雅美，雅美根本无意出嫁。林父林母紧张，就像米一样，老米在市场上是没有竞争力的。父母积极地为雅美安排相亲，雅美体贴父母的心意，答应了相亲。不过雅美有个但书，她无论如何不要嫁给做生意的人，她已经厌倦了做生意的忙碌，如果真要进入婚姻，她只想要找一个老老实实的上班族。

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第40集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: TRY科学第37集

programme.desc: 林雅美从小活泼聪明，林父身体不好，雅美从十岁开始学做生意，很快地展现她做生意的天赋，雅美是米行的超级业务员，同时也是四位妹妹的好大姊，不管有什么事情，天塌下来，总有大姊撑著。 雅美能干又漂亮，亭亭玉立正是适婚年纪，不过碾米厂家业全仰赖雅美，雅美根本无意出嫁。林父林母紧张，就像米一样，老米在市场上是没有竞争力的。父母积极地为雅美安排相亲，雅美体贴父母的心意，答应了相亲。不过雅美有个但书，她无论如何不要嫁给做生意的人，她已经厌倦了做生意的忙碌，如果真要进入婚姻，她只想要找一个老老实实的上班族。

programme.title: 大爱医生馆第6929集
programme.desc: 不断汲取新知，已是现代人必备的条件，对于人文精神的掌握，往往显得贫乏。大爱医生馆借由医师专业知识加上俯拾即是的美感经验与与回归人文思想的本怀，期望帮助忙碌的现代人多关心自己与周遭人的身心健康，为医疗节目注入生活化的素材。

programme.title: 看美善学美善美善剧场第731集
programme.desc: 京都富商的二女儿今井阿浅(波琉饰)在大阪创立矿碳公司、银行、生命保险公司等一系列活动，并竭尽全力设立日本第一所女子大学的故事。阿浅的人物原型是被称为明治时代女中豪杰的实业家广冈浅子。这是晨间剧故事首次从幕府末代拉开序幕，引发热议。同时出演的还有宫崎葵、寺岛忍、玉木宏等演员。

programme.title: 大爱真健康第1036集
programme.desc: 运动是对自己最好的投资，不只是为了瘦身、增肌，是为了更好的生活品质，每一天做一件对自己好的事，日子就会很踏实。 运动是一辈子的事，没时间运动不是借口，每天花三~五分钟时间，跟著「大爱真健康」做运动，让你愈动愈年轻、愈动愈健康！

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第60集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: MIT台湾志第629集
programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陆寻奇第2128集
programme.desc: 大陆寻奇是台湾目前最社教节目之冠不惜巨资的大制作足迹踏遍各现代城市、穷乡僻壤，深入各民族村落，记录了外人难得一见的生活情况，以准确的地理、历史定位，用现代化思维，把中华文化忠实的呈现。 漫游在浩瀚中国的世外桃源，细赏湖光山色间的粉妆玉琢，带您跋山涉水游遍奇峰峻岭，让您看尽壮阔山河叹为观止。

programme.title: 霹雳侠影之轰霆剑海录第74集
